title: Polypiler spec family 'intrinsics'
description: The body under 'spec' of a document in spec/intrinsics/<group in lower case>/<name in lower case>.yaml (PRD §4.1, §4.3): the contract of one intrinsic, which a backend lowers from and a recognizer rewrites to. Rules the schema cannot state (PLY0046): layout, vector-arity, vector-width, unique-name, integer-is-exact, type-bound; every TYPES., EFFECTS., IR., INTRINSICS. and VERIFICATION. id names an existing spec document (PLY0043).

name.description: PascalCase; the last segment of the id; its lower case is the file name; unique across the family, ignoring case.

group.description: The group; its lower case is the folder under spec/intrinsics/. Groups other than FloatMath, Trig, Matrix and Tensor are exact.

returns.description: Several for DivMod, SinCos or an add with carry.

fact.description: The kind of fact that proves the condition.

legality.description: The conditions under which the intrinsic has its result; outside them it traps or is undefined, as the text says.

effects.description: pure, or one or more EFFECTS. ids; pure excludes every other entry.

policy.description: The tolerance document the comparison of --verify uses.

exactness.description: exact: one result, the same bits on every target; tolerance: within the policy a VERIFICATION. tolerance document states.

algorithm.description: The defining algorithm, in words or pseudo-code.

mustSurviveUntil.description: The last IR stage that must still contain the intrinsic unlowered.

types.description: The TYPES. id each type parameter stands for in this vector.

vectors.description: Reference vectors: one input per parameter, one output per return value; data for the oracle, never produced by Polypiler.

attributes.description: Compile-time immediates with their inclusive range.

lowersTo.description: The INTRINSICS. and IR. documents a decomposition may use, in lowering order.

knownZeroBits.description: The bits of the result that are always 0.

knownOneBits.description: The bits of the result that are always 1.

facts.description: Derived value facts; the keys are a closed list.

laneLiftable.description: Whether the operation applies lane-wise to vectors; default false.

requiresRuntime.description: No decomposition exists and a runtime helper is required; default false.

spelling.description: The IR spelling when it differs from name, dotted PascalCase such as Memory.Copy; unique.

accuracy.description: For exactness.mode tolerance: ulp(<n>), cr or library(<name>).

type.description: A type parameter of the intrinsic or the id of a TYPES. document; a trailing [] makes it an array of that type.

scalar.description: A hexadecimal string, 0x followed by hex digits, which is the bit pattern; or a decimal integer, which is the value.

literal.description: A scalar, or for an array type a list of scalars; a value of a type of the family text is the list of its code units, and an array of such values a list of those lists.

element.description: An element of a list: a scalar, or the code units of a value of the family text.
